title: Reports
subtitle: Business reports over the ledgers — every report downloads as PDF or Excel.
asOfToday: Snapshot as of today ({{date}}) — not limited to a period

descriptions.sales: Orders, gross, VAT, net and discounts for the period, grouped the way you choose.
descriptions.pnl: Revenue minus costs for the period, with profit per model and expenses by category.
descriptions.discounts: Every discount given in the period and the reasons behind them.
descriptions.outstanding: Unpaid (invoiced or pending) income grouped by customer.
descriptions.inventory: Stock on hand of tracked products, valued at cost price.
descriptions.cashLedger: Cash handovers in the period and what each money holder is holding now.
descriptions.zreports: Daily closing summaries of completed POS sales.
descriptions.accountantPack: One Excel workbook with everything the accountant needs for a month.

download.failed: The file could not be downloaded

sales.caption: Sales grouped by {{group}}
sales.hint: Voided entries are excluded. Product grouping is built from POS sale and invoice lines.
sales.emptyHint: Choose a longer period or another grouping.

pnl.costsSub: Expenses + salaries (+ unit purchases when counted)
pnl.filteredTo: Revenue filtered to {{model}}; shared costs company-wide
pnl.perModelHint: Model bars show gross margin; shared costs sit on the "All models" bar. Green profit, red loss.
pnl.sharedOnlyHint: Costs cannot be assigned to a single model — they appear once on the All models row.
pnl.noModels: No revenue per model in this period
pnl.expenseCategoriesHint: Gross amounts of operating expenses in the period.
pnl.note: Per-model rows show revenue and gross margin only; shared costs (expenses and salaries) appear once on the "All models" row — matching the Excel calculation sheet.
pnl.noteFiltered: Revenue is filtered to {{model}}. Shared costs cannot be split per model and stay company-wide, so the headline profit is this model's revenue minus all shared costs.
pnl.emptyTitle: Nothing to report for this period
pnl.emptyHint: There is no revenue and no costs between these dates.

discounts.emptyHint: Discounts given on entries, POS sales and invoices appear here.

outstanding.emptyHint: Every invoiced and pending entry has been paid.

inventory.name: Product
inventory.noCostHint: This product has no cost price, so it adds nothing to the stock value.
inventory.hint: Only stock-tracked products with a positive quantity are valued (quantity × cost price).
inventory.emptyHint: Receive stock-tracked products to see their valuation here.

cash.heldOutsideSub: not yet handed to the company
cash.balancesHint: All-time totals per money holder, independent of the selected period.
cash.toHandOver: Still to be handed over to the company
cash.noHandoversHint: Cash handovers recorded under Cash & settlements appear here.
cash.emptyHint: There are no handovers and no money holders to report.

zreports.hint: Completed POS sales only. Method amounts are what was kept — cash change given back is deducted.
zreports.emptyTitle: No POS sales in this period
zreports.emptyHint: Daily Z summaries appear once sales are completed at the POS.

pack.title: Monthly accountant pack
pack.description: Pick a month and download one Excel workbook for the accountant.

entries.name: Entries
entries.hint: All income entries of the month

expenses.name: Expenses
expenses.hint: Purchases and costs with VAT details

payments.name: Payments
payments.hint: Money received, by method and receiver

creditNotes.name: CreditNotes
creditNotes.hint: Credit notes issued in the month

pack.auditNote: Every export is recorded in the audit log.
